method.class: CPU-only influence-guided deletion stress testing of regularized Bradley-Terry leaderboards on real crowdsourced preferences and sports results
method.description:
Estimate how deleting 0.1%, 0.5%, or 1% of observed comparisons changes rankings on disjoint partitions of the pinned Arena 55k and NBA snapshots. Fit a zero-sum, L2-regularized Bradley-Terry model, treating ties as half wins; use inverse-Hessian influence on leader-versus-contender margins to propose nested deletions, optionally refining by actual refits. Compare independently refitted disruption curves against matched random deletion and high-disagreement deletion. Report whether influence-guided selection finds greater, equal, or smaller disruption, not presumed superiority or a robustness certificate. Scope conclusions to the selected snapshots, graph components, ranking model, budgets, and deletion operation; do not infer that evaluation design itself causes between-dataset differences. Negative and inconclusive findings are valid. Publication requires uncertainty, controls, methodological audit, a conference-format paper, and reproducible code; these additional claim obligations must not become comparative search admission thresholds.
Runnable operationalization: fixed lambda=0.001, mean pairwise logloss plus lambda/2 times squared L2 norm, ties=half wins, zero-sum logits, float64. Trusted sparse L-BFGS solver is independent of candidate Newton code. Rank by descending logits rounded to 8 decimals then participant integer code. The actual candidate must provide bounded clean-fit and inverse-Hessian certificates for a clean leader versus any nonleader contender; verify gradient infinity norm <2e-7, zero mean <1e-7, clean logit error <2e-4, H-direction residual <2e-7 and row-influence error <2e-6. Deletions must be the nested prefixes of ascending certified influence rounded to 10 decimals, stable row-key ties; exactly floor(n*f) at f=0.001,0.005,0.01. No post-selection refinement trace is implemented in this minimal scaffold; choosing contender is a legal optimization axis. Mathematical certificates establish an operational method test, not exhaustive proof of hidden internal computation; later source audit remains publication evidence.

Each seed runs Arena original, Arena reverse-row nonidentity permutation, NBA original, NBA reverse-row permutation. No replay, auxiliary reset or extra candidate evaluation. Observed endpoints, outcomes and integer row keys are legitimate analysis inputs; no evaluator reference scores, baseline masks, scoring state, bootstrap outcomes, resource paths or files travel over RPC. All state transfer is inline base64, little-endian float64 [n,4] input and UTF-8 JSON certificate output, backed by candidate-owned memory only. Each logical transfer <=64 MiB, <=8 chunks, decoded chunk<=8 MiB, staging<=128 MiB. n<=100000, participants<=256. Complete JSON envelopes including newline are strictly <64 MiB, target<16 MiB. Largest preflight chunk request=11184891 bytes and response=11184862 bytes including representative 64-bit id envelope; metadata=217 bytes. Maximum-shape certificate using extreme finite floats and longest numeric row keys serializes to 2540075 logical UTF-8 bytes, 3386768 base64 bytes. Runtime independently bounds every actual message. Per-episode MAXIMUM operation table: reset=1, stale export_chunk=1, import_start=1, import_chunk=8, import_commit=1, solve=1, export_start=1, export_chunk=8, release=1, TOTAL=23. Count all eight declared chunks even when actual input/output needs one. Invocation caps: 8*23=184 search, 20*23=460 final; smoke each 4*23=92. These replace the design's loose 64-per-episode upper bounds, not its scientific workload.

Normalization fixed before feature extraction: parse Arena text-turn JSON (null canonicalizes to empty string; conservatively hash and group empty turns too), NFKC and collapse Unicode whitespace. Union rows sharing ANY prompt or response turn or normalized full example; ignore source IDs only for content hashes, keep IDs and source-row provenance separately. NBA retain _iscopy=0, canonicalize dates, unordered original team identities and aligned observed scores into an event hash. Collapse exact normalized example duplicates within a plane. Whole connected content groups split by SHA256(canonical JSON ['split-v1-20261027',family,min_example_hash_in_group]) modulo 100<30 for search, otherwise final. Both full-source hash and protected-text hash intersections and source-ID intersections audited empty BEFORE participant/outcome feature extraction; manifests retain provenance and cross-plane audit commitments. Largest undirected participant component by participant count with lexicographic tie-break; self-comparisons excluded, no performance-based row selection. NBA historical team codes/eras are heterogeneous. Immutable upstream notices and generic mathematics are not held-out examples. Runtime reads only its plane root resolved from TASK_SOURCE_DIR or evaluator directory and verifies local payload checksums and membership. Full raw originals remain private temporary acquisition assets, never submission/runtime inputs.

Predeclared evaluator-owned controls: (1) copy/no-edit independently refit empty masks at all three nominal budgets, require identical ranks, zero Kendall disruption and zero leader drop; (2) on the SAME actual graph require nonstationary zero-logit substitution and rejection of constant logit/zero-influence certificate through the actual validator, otherwise vacuous/fail; (3) after reset an actual export_chunk using preceding live in-memory output token must reject unknown token (first uses an invalid token), followed by independently validated fresh clean fit; (4) actual-method reversed-row permutation must change serialized input, map row keys identically, preserve certified logits within2e-5 and selected masks exactly and disruption within1e-8. Matched original/permuted episodes share seed, observed content, budgets and no feedback. First case's permutation control is completed only by its paired case. No identity controls or state_changed flags establish validity. Wire-schema failures and scientific certificate failures have separate bounded categories. Missing, failed or vacuous controls fail validity and operational qualification, with zero control contribution.

Aggregation is fixed: three budgets 1/3; original/permuted cases 1/2; seeds 1/2 search or1/5 final; Arena/NBA families1/2. This equals the flat complete-episode mean for episode scalars. Four controls each1/4 within episode. Primary combined_score is independently refitted normalized Kendall pair-order disagreement, higher means discovered sensitivity, not quality of leaderboard or proven robustness. Baselines and candidate use identical model, rows, fractions, and deterministic fitting criteria. Leader rank drop normalized by m-1. Paired gains formed before aggregation. Missing/failed episodes remain candidate disruption=0, leader drop=0, baseline disruption=1, paired gains=-1, completion=0, uncompleted controls=0; never retry, drop, or renormalize. A baseline failure cancels expensive later work but preserves all remaining reset obligations and finite penalties.

Search correct requires completed declared transcript, legal finite traffic, split integrity, independent valid BT fits, actual-method certificate/selection checks, required baselines and all four nonvacuous controls per episode, complete fixed finite aggregation. NO superiority, minimum disruption, adaptivity, or significance gate. Search eligibility=search correct; rank eligible candidates by combined_score only. Final correct separately repeats these scientific/completeness checks on sealed data and requires predeclared uncertainty; nonpositive gains remain valid results. Publication claims are separate and require paper/code evidence, not automatically search admission vetoes. Final 256 deterministic paired seed bootstrap resamples give bounded 2.5/97.5 percentile intervals; smoke8. Conditional group bootstrap:32 per family, first seed, fixed candidate/random/disagreement masks, clean and9 perturbed weighted refits; smoke2. Not attack reoptimization and not population proof. Failed replicates retain candidate0/comparators1/gains-1 and invalidate completeness; failed intervals conservatively[-1,1]. No candidate calls or feedback during uncertainty.

Platform: Linux x86_64; native smoke additionally requires Landlock ABI>=1 (kernel>=5.13) and libseccomp.so.2 and fails closed if unavailable; CPython>=3.11 (draft verified3.12), numpy2.2.6/scipy1.15.3 CPU binary wheels. Four aggregate CPU cores/eight GiB, evaluator2 cores/four GiB and candidate2 cores/four GiB, no GPUs or runtime network. Native smoke uses fresh explicit environment, empty HOME, candidate-only copied code, Landlock filesystem denial, seccomp no-network/no-process-escape, affinity2 and RLIMIT_CPU=2*plane_wall,4GiB address space; process-group termination and bounded stderr capture. Production requires BOTH exact /broker-code/candidate_proxy.py and socket variable, importing handle in-process only; harness owns frozen candidate resource/isolation attestation. Never consume harness telemetry. Single monotonic plane deadline starts before setup with conservative120s startup allowance (smoke8),90s finalization(smoke5), global remaining-reset reserves and episode overhead3s. Reset bound10s(smoke3), per-RPC cap300s(smoke10), matched per-method productive allowances60s search/180s final(smoke3), separate shared clean-fit allowance and .6s in-process bookkeeping each. Native terminate .3s+kill/reap .5s+stderr .4s fit3s overhead; final close fits finalization. Joint five-method reservation totals2714s search/18470s final before extra final uncertainty (<=12600s) and slack; neither task.md nor design delegates a productive baseline-time floor. Watchdog bounds trusted fits/metrics and all candidate work. No synthetic dataset replacement, no fabricated timing or completed-production claim. Smoke preserves identical loaders, protocol, fits, controls, aggregation, imports and isolation while using<=1024 real rows and<=12 connected selected participants, first plane seed only. Reduced smoke does not attest full production qualification or scientific publication.

protocol.promotion_rule: Harness-owned only: at most three complete one-evaluation idea cycles; eligibility is search correct=true without comparative threshold. Rank by descending finite combined_score, exact ties by earlier evaluation ordinal then lexicographically smaller frozen-source SHA256. Freeze highest eligible source/dependencies before sealed final. No eligible candidate means no promotion. Final validity is distinct from publication claim support.

search_proxies.name: content_group_search_partition
search_proxies.preserves: Both real evaluation designs, BT model, deletion fractions, trusted refits, baselines and matched controls.
search_proxies.omits: Held-out content groups, final-only seeds, final uncertainty and publication deliverables; search is development evidence only.

search_visible: Documented handle input/output conventions, candidate-visible starter code inside program_0/src, and only the search comparison episodes with their permitted observed outcomes and workload settings.

Trusted search scalar metrics, scientific-validity diagnostics, control pass/fail summaries, and bounded search-only development evidence from at most three complete candidate evaluations. Never reveal final seeds, examples, manifests, references, targets, or metrics before freeze.
final_sealed: Privileged design and contract artifacts containing final seeds, private split/hash manifests and resources/final; after candidate freeze reveal only legitimate observed comparison inputs needed for each final episode, with no private reference or scoring data.

Final clean/refit ranks, baseline outputs, correctness decisions, per-episode scores, uncertainty resamples, aggregate metrics and publication assessment remain evaluator-owned and unavailable for candidate adaptation. Release scientific evidence for the frozen submission only under the final reporting policy.

required_evidence: Later scaffold and validation must produce actual contract provenance bound to the canonical task SHA-256, immutable evaluator/resource digests, pinned upstream revisions/licenses/entrypoints, verified supplied raw checksums, requirements.txt pins and offline installation evidence. Do not assert that these artifacts or validations already exist. Keep raw data out of the code repository and manuscript submission while documenting reproducible allowed downloads and attribution.

A trusted content-split audit must record fixed pre-split normalization, full-example and text-component SHA-256 hashes, prompt grouping, NBA game deduplication, source IDs, row provenance, split seed/manifests, exclusions and explicit empty cross-plane normalized-content intersections before feature extraction. Shared immutable upstream code is not an example leak; distinct dataset IDs or directories are not a disjointness proof.

Production payload preflight must serialize representative largest actual requests and responses with UTF-8 JSON, 4*ceil(binary_bytes/3) base64 expansion, dtype/shape/chunk metadata, envelope and framing. Report exact complete-message byte counts strictly below 64 MiB, finite logical-size bounds, in-memory-only chunk backing and every chunk RPC in the contract caps. Validate no shared paths, filenames, file handles, host mounts or private targets appear in candidate traffic.

Trusted validation must show full production and smoke reset cardinality/order against search_reset_sequence, final_reset_sequence, search_smoke_reset_sequence and final_smoke_reset_sequence, globally across all connections and restarts; one reset per independent case-seed episode, none inserted for workload configuration, no undeclared replay. Include bounded failure cancellation, preserved missing contributions, baseline-failure handling and remaining-reset behavior. Empty-HOME offline smoke exercises reduced real workloads, not completed production runs.

Resource evidence must distinguish harness-enforced elapsed deadlines, all-thread CPU/memory role limits and broker RPC caps from advisory candidate iteration/refinement counts. The canonical task requires a one-week CPU-only campaign, not a hard objective-evaluation count. No candidate-reported counter or numeric iteration argument is proof of a hard internal compute cap. Disclose setup, baselines, training, refits, bootstrap, cleanup and manuscript/reproduction costs without inventing throughput or completed launches.

Provide the frozen candidate source/dependency digests, pre-final eligibility/ranking/tie-break record and no more than three one-evaluation idea cycles. Preserve unsuccessful ideas and incomplete runs. Trusted code audit and residual certificates must identify real Bradley-Terry fitting, actual inverse-Hessian influence computation and selection/refinement, rather than method-name aliases, copied baseline outputs or candidate self-reported metrics.

Predeclared matched constant/copy/reset/nonidentity-permutation controls, expected behavior, budgets and feedback boundaries must be checked on the actual implementation, with nonvacuity checks and all finite failed/missing contributions retained. Provide independent baseline/refit solver diagnostics, numerical tolerances and convergence evidence, all deletion-budget curves, exact scalar metrics and their fixed aggregation weights. Never infer robustness or causality from a vacuous or failed control.

Final scientific evidence must cover both Arena human preferences and NBA results, with graph/component/participant/time coverage, tie and regularization policy, deletion fraction comparability, random and high-disagreement baselines, paired gains, clean score margins and uncertainty. Separate conditional optimization-seed variability from fixed-mask content-group bootstrap evidence, acknowledge their limited power and lack of full attack reoptimization, and report negative or incomplete findings honestly. Do not generalize two datasets into a causal evaluation-design effect or a universal robustness certificate.

Produce a complete research paper as PDF plus LaTeX source using the latest official NeurIPS template available when drafting the paper, verify the actual edition and main-track page limit from official sources, and complete its required checklist. Include abstract, introduction, related work, method, experiments, discussion/limitations and authentic inspected references. Every table/figure/number must trace to actual trusted runs and a reproducing script/command; include environment versions, seeds, expected runtimes, data instructions and a script-to-figure map. Publication correctness additionally assesses these deliverables rather than treating evaluator score as a paper acceptance certificate. No design-time benchmark numbers or successful validation are claimed.

Respect the task independent-research restriction: do not search for, identify, infer, visit or use the prohibited prior paper or any mirror, abstract, commentary, discussion, derivative page or code. The provided permitted literature may be used without traversing citation/discussion links into prohibited material. Restrict network use to allowed data acquisition, unrelated permitted literature and dependency/template installation. Stop immediately on accidental exposure and record the location and amount seen without further investigation. Disclose any LLM assistance in the paper; never fabricate references, data, outputs or completion claims.
